resources.string: Watches Instagram and presses Back when the main Reels tab or feed is opened. Reels shared inside Direct Message chats are left alone.
Block the main Reels tab. Reels sent in DMs still play.
Accessibility service is off — enable it in Settings
Blocker is paused. Reels are not blocked.
Turn the switch on, then enable “Instagram Reels Blocker” in Accessibility settings.

When Instagram’s main Reels tab is open, the service issues a Back action so you leave that feed. Reels inside a Direct chat thread are not blocked.\n\nAfter installing an update, turn this service off and on again in Accessibility settings. On Samsung, you may also need App info → three dots → Allow restricted settings.
